is it worth repairing or replacing a 15 year old ac
For a 15-year-old AC, replacement is often worth considering, especially if it has had repeated breakdowns, needs a major repair, or struggles to cool. But age

For a 15-year-old AC, replacement is often worth considering, especially if it has had repeated breakdowns, needs a major repair, or struggles to cool. But age alone doesn’t decide it—a relatively small repair may still make sense if the system has otherwise been reliable.

The useful next step depends on whether it’s currently broken or you’re planning ahead:

Broken and needs troubleshooting: Budget’s HVAC Diagnostic Service Call is $99 for one system. That covers the trip and diagnosis; repairs, parts, and refrigerant are quoted separately and need your approval before work starts.
Want a replacement quote: Budget’s HVAC Equipment Estimate is free, but it’s a written equipment estimate—not troubleshooting or repair.

If you tell me whether it’s broken now, what the problem is, and your service address, I can help identify the right lane and check whether the stated service area applies. No booking has been made.
